banks.name: Bank of America

banks.name: HSBC
banks.focus: M&A, ECM, DCM, project finance — the HK home-market giant

banks.style_notes: HSBC is THE HK bank — local knowledge + Mandarin + mainland experience = high fit; Greater Bay Area cross-border angle is a perfect hook. The video screen explicitly filters scripted answers — answer naturally, do not recite. Apply via the Early Careers portal specifically.

banks.name: UBS

banks.name: Deutsche Bank

banks.process: Apply db.com/careers -> SHL (2 tests) -> video interview -> 1st round 2 rounds (HR behavioral + analyst/associate technical) -> superday 2-3 rounds (VP/MD behavioral/fit + deal discussion; lower technical depth than top BBs) -> offer

banks.name: Barclays

banks.process: Apply barclays.com/careers -> HireVue -> 1st round 2 rounds (technical + behavioral) -> superday 2-3 rounds (VP/MD: fit + deal discussion + market view); smaller team, less formal process -> offer
banks.style_notes: Smaller HK team = fewer applicants competing; looser screen leaves more room for the differentiated cross-border narrative. Safe BB.

banks.name: BNP Paribas
banks.assessment: SHL (numerical + verbal + abstract, ~50-60 min) -> video interview (3-4 Q)
banks.process: Apply group.bnpparibas/careers -> SHL (3 tests, 7-day window) -> video interview -> 1st round 1-2 rounds -> superday 2 rounds (fit + deal discussion) -> offer
banks.style_notes: Solid French BB with real HK IB scale; Mandarin helps China client coverage. Safe BB, no major corrections.

banks.style_notes: PRIMARY TARGET. Mandarin + Alibaba = near-perfect Asia-advisory profile; cross-border knowledge is the core differentiator. URGENT: HK portal may already be open (US timeline was Mar-Apr) — check today. Start networking now. No finance internship -> Lazard weighs deal-thinking; answer with a strong case.

banks.name: Rothschild & Co
banks.focus: M&A advisory, cross-border deals, debt advisory

banks.style_notes: PRIMARY TARGET. Cross-border M&A is Rothschild's core — Alibaba BD + Mandarin = precise profile. CONFIRMED: the HK role does NOT require a prior finance internship (only the US role did) — Alibaba BD satisfies it. Apply HK portal only; prepare specific cross-border deal theses.

banks.name: CICC (China International Capital Corp)
banks.focus: M&A, ECM, DCM — China's top investment bank
banks.assessment: Written exam (90 min, online proctored): Part A financial accounting (45 min) + Part B finance & valuation (45 min), sometimes Part C mini-case (30 min) -> Mandarin video interview
banks.process: Apply en.cicc.com/join-cicc day one (rolling — offers may go out before the deadline) -> written exam (~90-120 min, proctored): A (45 min) income-statement build / BS items / cash flow / ratios (ROE/ROIC/net-debt-EBITDA); B (45 min) DCF (WACC/terminal/sensitivity) / comps (EV/EBITDA/PE selection+interpretation) / M&A math (accretion-dilution/PPA/synergies) / basic LBO (leverage/MOIC/IRR); C (sometimes, 30 min) mini-case -> Mandarin video (3-4 Q, all or bilingual Mandarin): intro / why IB / why CICC / walk through a recent deal, 2-3 min each -> 1st round 2 rounds (mostly Mandarin): analyst/associate (background / why China IB / written-exam follow-ups / deal discussion); associate/VP (full DCF walk-through / LBO build / EV vs equity value in an LBO) -> 2nd round (VP/director, 60 min): live deal case (1-page brief, 10-min read, discuss valuation/strategy/buy-side-sell-side); China M&A landscape (SOE reform / outbound / HK re-listing / sector views) -> MD final: fit + strategic vision + why CICC specifically -> verbal -> written offer
banks.style_notes: TOP TARGET, highest match (10/10). Mandarin REQUIRED (you have it); Alibaba BD = direct China deal-ecosystem exposure = huge differentiator; 3.8 GPA + Math = academic-elite signal. CICC recognizes UVA as a top global university. The written exam is the main gate — invest the most prep time here. Rolling, submit day one.

banks.name: CITIC Securities International
banks.assessment: Financial written exam (~80 min, online proctored): accounting (40 min) + finance (40 min) -> Mandarin video interview
banks.process: Apply cs.ecitic.com/careers -> written exam (~80 min): accounting (3-statement linkage / ratio analysis / working capital / deferred taxes); finance (DCF / comps / precedent transactions / basic M&A) -> Mandarin video (3-4 Q, incl. knowledge of CITIC's main business lines) -> 1st round 2 rounds (mostly Mandarin): technical follow-ups + deep-dive on the Alibaba experience -> superday 1-2 rounds (VP/MD): recent CITIC deal discussion + HK capital-markets understanding -> offer
banks.style_notes: Strong fit — Mandarin + Alibaba tie directly to HK IPOs + cross-border deals. Written exam is the main gate; master accounting + valuation. Apply early.

banks.name: China Renaissance
banks.assessment: Take-home case study (2-3 day deadline). No standardized online test.
banks.process: Apply chinarenaissance.com/careers or email the HK IBD team directly (STRONGLY prefer direct contact — relationship-driven, small team) -> take-home case (2-3 days): a Chinese new-economy company considering an acquisition or strategic deal. Deliver: (A) strategic rationale; (B) rough valuation (EV/Revenue for high-growth, EV/EBITDA for mature, DCF for cash-flow businesses) + a short DCF; (C) 3-5 key risks; (D) 1-2 page recommendation memo. Cold-master Alibaba/Tencent/ByteDance/Meituan/JD competitive landscape -> case presentation (45-60 min, 2-3 interviewers): present findings, expect deep probing on every assumption — defend valuation choices, test thinking under pressure -> 2nd round (VP: deep deal discussion; MD: fit + long-term vision + why China Renaissance vs CICC) -> offer
banks.style_notes: TOP TARGET, highest match (10/10), the single most compelling story on the list. Alibaba BD = first-hand China new-economy; China Renaissance advises exactly the companies you know deeply; the internship itself is deal-relevant experience. Gap: the case needs technical execution (DCF/comps) — master before applying. You're in HK now — push for an in-person meeting.
